# Dreamline Production — Kolkata's Premier Cinematic Production House
# Version: 1.0
# Last Updated: 2026-06-09
# Full Version: https://dreamlineproduction.com/llms-full.txt

> Dreamline Production is a full-service cinematic production house based in Kolkata, India. Founded by Rony Santra with over 15 years of experience, we offer corporate films, ad films, luxury wedding photography & cinematography, podcast production, line production, drone videography, 3D area mapping, 2D animation, live streaming, and professional interview setups for news channels and media agencies. We serve clients across all of India.

## Core Services

### Corporate & Commercial
- [Corporate Films & Ad Films](https://dreamlineproduction.com/commercial): End-to-end corporate film production — concept, scripting, shooting, editing, color grading. Brand campaigns, product videos, and corporate documentaries for companies like TATA Trust, L&T, and Carlsberg.
- [Podcast Production](https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/podcast): Complete podcast production including studio setup, multi-camera recording, professional audio engineering, editing, and post-production for video podcasts.
- [Line Production](https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/line-production): Full on-ground production support in Kolkata and eastern India — crew hiring, location scouting, equipment, permits, transportation, and logistics for ad agencies, international crews, and film teams.
- [News Channel & Agency Interviews](https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/interviews): Professional interview setups for national and international media. Broadcast-ready camera crews, lighting, audio. Regular work with Al Jazeera, ABP Network, TV Today, and other major media organizations.

### Technology & Visual Effects
- [Drone Videography & Aerial Shoots](https://dreamlineproduction.com/tech): Professional drone video for real estate, construction, events, and commercial projects. Cinematic aerial footage with DGCA-certified pilots.
- [3D Area Mapping & Visualization](https://dreamlineproduction.com/tech): 3D mapping for construction sites, real estate visualization, architectural walkthroughs, and land survey mapping using drone data.
- [2D Animation & Motion Graphics](https://dreamlineproduction.com/tech): Motion graphics, explainer videos, animated logos, title sequences, and promotional animations for brands and businesses.

### Weddings & Events
- [Luxury Wedding Photography & Cinematography](https://dreamlineproduction.com/luxury): Cinematic wedding documentation with candid photography, storytelling, drone coverage, and premium editing. Both-side wedding packages start from ₹40,000 per day. Fully customizable packages.
- [Corporate Event Coverage & Live Streaming](https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/corporate): Professional event photography, conference coverage, corporate headshots, and live streaming & broadcast services.
- [Fashion Photography](https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/fashion): Professional fashion shoots for portfolios, brands, and designers.
- [Pre-Wedding Photography](https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/pre-wedding): Creative pre-wedding shoots with cinematic storytelling, drone shots, and stunning locations.
- [Brand Promotion](https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/brand-promotion): Social media videos, product photography, campaign shoots, and digital marketing assets.
- [Documentary Production](https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/documentary): Documentary filmmaking for NGOs, corporates, and independent projects.
- [Corporate Films](https://dreamlineproduction.com/services/corporate-films): Dedicated corporate film production and brand videos.
